tier_reason: Real independent client, no wrapper alternative for native Apple platforms. Unlike react/angular (see erghi-sdks' PARITY.md for that decision), this SDK is not redundant with anything and stays actively invested.
sync_note: This file is the SOURCE of truth for Swift's capability surface. erghi-sdks (the canonical multi-language SDK repo) keeps a manually-synced REFERENCE COPY at docs/parity/swift.json for its generated PARITY.md matrix, because SPM requires Package.swift at repo root and this SDK can't live inside that monorepo. Whoever edits this file's capabilities should also update erghi-sdks/docs/parity/swift.json in a follow-up PR there (or note it in this PR's description so a human does) -- there is no CI link between the two repos yet.
verification_method: Read Sources/ErghiSDK/Resources/*.swift and ErghiClient.swift directly against erghi-conversation-api controllers.

chat.evidence: Sources/ErghiSDK/Resources/ChatResource.swift:19-100 -- getConversation/createConversation/getMessages/sendMessage/markAsRead; no listConversations, closeConversation, or sendTyping. Same gap shape as the flutter SDK in erghi-sdks.

realtime.protocol: signalr-hub-over-websocket, hand-rolled negotiate handshake over Starscream WebSocket (no native Swift SignalR client exists)

rag.note: No SDK in erghi-sdks wraps RAG either -- platform-wide gap, not swift-specific.

webhooks.note: No customer-facing outbound webhook API exists on the platform yet.

notes: Missing listConversations/closeConversation/sendTyping and password-reset/email-verification -- the real active-tier catch-up target for this SDK, tracked alongside the equivalent flutter gap in erghi-sdks' PARITY.md. See that repo's parity-tracking PR (ErghiPlatform/erghi-sdks#15) for the full cross-SDK picture this file is one piece of.
